<USER_REQUEST>
CONTINUE — READ-ONLY SIRUMALAI SAR BASELINE AUDIT

Tool execution has now been restored after fixing the broken local Google Cloud telemetry plugin.

Do NOT modify code or database yet.
Do NOT acquire a new satellite image.
Do NOT create fake/demo data.
Do NOT reset, seed, delete, or recreate records.
Do NOT modify Vadipatti production data.

Perform ONLY a read-only audit of the existing Sirumalai SAR baseline data.

Audit the complete data lineage:

SatelliteMetadata
→ Baseline
→ GEE Export Task
→ Google Drive
→ Local GeoTIFF
→ Raster Validation
→ 14 Baseline Gates

1. SIRUMALAI SATELLITE METADATA

Find every SatelliteMetadata record associated with Sirumalai.

For each record report:
- _id
- imageId
- acquisitionDate
- sensorType
- source
- processingStatus
- intersectingZones
- geeExportTaskId
- driveFileId
- driveFileName
- driveFileSizeBytes
- localRasterPath
- rasterValidated
- rasterBandCount
- rasterWidth
- rasterHeight
- rasterCrs
- rasterResolution
- createdAt
- updatedAt

2. SIRUMALAI BASELINES

Find every Baseline associated with Sirumalai.

For each report:
- baseline _id
- satelliteMetadataId
- monitoringTrack
- status
- activation status
- acquisition date
- imageId

Verify that every satelliteMetadataId actually exists.

3. GEE EXPORT TASKS

For every Sirumalai SAR SatelliteMetadata record with geeExportTaskId:

Query the REAL Earth Engine operation.

Report:
- operation ID
- done
- error
- current state
- whether export actually completed successfully

IMPORTANT:
Do not create another export task.

4. GOOGLE DRIVE

For every completed GEE export:

Check the real Google Drive target folder.

Report:
- Drive file found/not found
- file ID
- filename
- file size
- whether it matches the SatelliteMetadata driveFileName

5. LOCAL RASTER

Check whether the expected local raster exists.

For every existing TIFF report:
- path
- file size
- width
- height
- band count
- CRS
- resolution
- VV/VH bands
- raster validation result

6. DATE ISSUE

The UI previously showed dates such as:
- 1/6/2026
- 1/1/2021

There was also discussion of a possible 2020 UTC observation.

Do NOT change any dates.

Report the exact:
- imageId
- acquisitionDate in UTC
- displayed/local date

Determine whether any apparent 2020/2021 discrepancy is simply timezone conversion.

7. 14-GATE AUDIT

For each Sirumalai SAR baseline candidate evaluate:

Gate 1 — SatelliteMetadata exists
Gate 2 — Real GEE asset ID
Gate 3 — Valid acquisition date
Gate 4 — Supported SAR sensor
Gate 5 — GEE export task ID exists
Gate 6 — GEE operation actually completed successfully
Gate 7 — Google Drive file ID exists
Gate 8 — Drive file size > 0
Gate 9 — Local raster exists
Gate 10 — rasterValidated = true
Gate 11 — VV/VH band count valid
Gate 12 — width/height valid
Gate 13 — CRS valid
Gate 14 — SAR radar/backscatter validation valid

For every gate report PASS/FAIL and the actual value.

IMPORTANT:
Gate 6 must mean the GEE operation actually completed successfully.
A task ID alone is NOT Gate 6 PASS.

8. CATALOG VS BASELINE

Compare:

Satellite Catalog records
vs
Baseline candidate records
vs
SatelliteMetadata records

Identify exactly why records visible in one screen may not appear in another.

9. DATABASE SAFETY

Record collection counts before the audit and confirm that no records were modified.

Verify Vadipatti remains unchanged:

ZONE-260913-7787
- Optical enabled
- SAR disabled
- existing Optical baseline unchanged
- existing ChangeDetection unchanged
- existing Alert unchanged

FINAL OUTPUT

Report ONLY:

A. Sirumalai SatelliteMetadata records
B. Sirumalai Baseline records
C. GEE task status
D. Drive status
E. Local raster status
F. 14-gate results
G. Catalog/Baseline mismatch
H. Root cause
I. Exact minimal fix required

STOP after the audit.

DO NOT implement the fix yet.
</USER_REQUEST>
